blocks.text: Qayta so'roq: Are you? Do you? Have you?

Suhbatda biror yangilikni eshitganda o'zbekcha «Shunaqami?», «Rostdanmi?» deymiz yoki gapni qaytarib so'raymiz: «Men Buxorodanman. — **Buxorodanmisiz?**» Inglizlar buning uchun qisqa **qayta so'roq** ishlatadi: **yordamchi fe'l + olmosh + ?** I'm from Bukhara. — **Are you?** Bu haqiqiy savol emas: suhbatdosh javob kutmaydi, faqat qiziqish yoki hayratini bildiradi va suhbatni davom ettiradi. Shuning uchun undan keyin ko'pincha izoh yoki yangi savol keladi: Are you? My grandmother is from there too.

Yordamchi fe'l 40-darsdagidek tanlanadi: gapda be, have, can, will bo'lsa — o'sha; Present Simple va Past Simple da — **do / does / did**. Ega olmoshga aylanadi (Emma → she, the museum → it), **I** va **you** o'rin almashadi: I'm tired. — Are **you**? Darak gapga darak, inkor gapga inkor qayta so'roq beriladi: I don't eat fish. — **Don't you?** Tom has never flown. — **Hasn't he?** (never — inkor so'z).

items.text: I've just got a new job. — **Have you?** Congratulations!
My brother doesn't like plov. — **Doesn't he?** That's unusual.
We were in Tashkent last month. — **Were you?** Why didn't you call me?
items.translation: O'tgan oy Toshkentda edik. — **Shunaqami?** Nega menga qo'ng'iroq qilmadingiz?

blocks.text: Qayta so'roq odatda ko'tariluvchi, jonli ohangda aytiladi. Pasayuvchi, sovuq ohangda u loqaydlikdek eshitilishi mumkin. Shuning uchun undan keyin izoh qo'shing: Are you? **How nice!** / Did you? **Why?**
Tasdiq so'roqlari: It's nice, isn't it?

Gap oxiriga qo'shiladigan qisqa savol — **question tag** (tasdiq so'rog'i, «dumcha»). O'zbekchada uning o'rnida «-a?», «shundaymi?», «to'g'rimi?» keladi: Havo ajoyib, **a**? Inglizcha dumcha ham suhbatdoshdan rozilik yoki tasdiq so'raydi. Farqi shundaki, o'zbekcha «shundaymi?» hamma gapga bir xil qo'shiladi, inglizcha dumcha esa har gal gapning fe'liga qarab yasaladi.

Qoida: **darak gap → inkor dumcha**, **inkor gap → darak dumcha**. Dumchada gapning yordamchi fe'li (Present Simple va Past Simple da — do / does / did) va ega o'rnidagi olmosh turadi: It **is** cold, **isn't it**? You **like** tea, **don't you**? Tom **can't** swim, **can he**? Nega ishora teskari? Dumcha aslida «... emasmi?» ma'nosini beradi: darak fikrni inkor so'roq bilan, inkor fikrni darak so'roq bilan tekshiramiz.

items.text: You didn't lock the car, **did you**?

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning eng ko'p xatosi — «isn't it?» ni hamma gapga qo'shish (o'zbekcha «shundaymi?» kabi): «You like tea, isn't it?» → **You like tea, don't you?**; «Aziz was here, isn't it?» → **Aziz was here, wasn't he?** Ikkinchi xato — **I am** ning dumchasi: «I'm late, amn't I?» → **I'm late, aren't I?** (maxsus shakl).

Ohang ma'noni o'zgartiradi. **Pasayuvchi** ohang — gapiruvchi javobni biladi, faqat rozilik kutyapti: It's a lovely day, isn't it? **Ko'tariluvchi** ohang — haqiqiy savol, gapiruvchi aniq bilmaydi: You're Madina's brother, aren't you? Yozuvda ikkalasi bir xil ko'rinadi, ma'no vaziyatdan tushuniladi.

Inglizcha javob **faktga** qarab beriladi, savolning shakliga emas: fakt darak bo'lsa — **Yes**, inkor bo'lsa — **No**. O'zbekchada esa «ha» ko'pincha «siz haqsiz» degani: «Siz rus emassiz, shundaymi? — **Ha**, rus emasman.» Inglizchada bu — **No**, I'm not. Bu yerda «Yes» desangiz, «Yes, I am Russian» deb tushunishadi.

items.text: You aren't Russian, are you? — **No, I'm not**. I'm Uzbek.
items.translation: Siz rus emassiz, shundaymi? — **Ha, rus emasman**. O'zbekman.

items.text: You don't work on Sundays, do you? — **Yes, I do**, but only in the morning.
items.translation: Yakshanba kuni ishlamaysiz, a? — **Yo'q, ishlayman**, lekin faqat ertalab.

blocks.text: Inglizchada **Yes** doim darak fe'l bilan, **No** doim inkor fe'l bilan keladi: **Yes, I am.** / **No, I'm not.** «Yes, I'm not» yoki «No, I am» degan javob bo'lmaydi. Inkor savolga javob berishdan oldin o'zingizdan so'rang: «Fakt qanday — rusmanmi yoki yo'qmi?»

Maxsus dumchalar: I'm ..., **aren't I**? · Let's ..., **shall we**? (→ 35-dars) · There's ..., **isn't there**? (→ 37-dars). Qisqa javoblar — → 40-dars; savolda so'z tartibi va inkor savollar (Why isn't ...? Don't you ...?) — → 44-dars.

Eslab qolish: qayta so'roq — gapning oddiy aksi, ishora o'zgarmaydi (I'm tired. — **Are you?**). Dumcha — teskari aks: yordamchi fe'l o'sha, ishora teskari (It's hot, **isn't it**? / It isn't hot, **is it**?).

rows: teskari: It's hot, **isn't it**? / It isn't, **is it**?
faktga qarab: **No, I'm not.** / **Yes, I am.**

examples.title: Echo questions: **Are you?** **Is it?** **Was it?**
examples.description: **be** bilan qayta so'roq: gap darak bo'lsa — **Are you? / Is she? / Were you?**, inkor bo'lsa — **Isn't it? / Aren't they?** U qiziqish yoki hayratni bildiradi, ko'pincha izoh bilan davom etadi.

sentences.text: I'm from Bukhara. — **Are you?** My grandmother was born there too.
sentences.translation: Men Buxorodanman. — **Buxorodanmisiz?** Buvim ham o'sha yerda tug'ilgan.

sentences.text: Emma is a vegetarian. — **Is she?** I didn't know that.
sentences.translation: Emma vegetarian. — **Rostdanmi?** Buni bilmagan ekanman.

sentences.text: The museum isn't open today. — **Isn't it?** What a pity.
sentences.translation: Muzey bugun ochiq emas. — **Ochiq emasmi?** Attang.

sentences.text: We were in Oxford last summer. — **Were you?** Did you like it?
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda Oksfordda edik. — **Shunaqami?** Yoqdimi?

sentences.text: My parents aren't at home this weekend. — **Aren't they?** Where are they?
sentences.translation: Ota-onam bu dam olish kunlari uyda emas. — **Uyda emasmi?** Qayerdalar?

sentences.text: The test was really easy. — **Was it?** I found it quite hard.
sentences.translation: Test juda oson edi. — **Oson edimi?** Menga ancha qiyin tuyuldi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I'm not ready yet. — **Aren't you?** But the taxi is outside!
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, men hali tayyor emasman. — **Tayyor emasmisiz?** Taksi esa eshik oldida!

sentences.text: Bekzod is getting married in May. — **Is he?** That's wonderful news!
sentences.translation: Bekzod mayda uylanyapti. — **Rostdanmi?** Bu ajoyib yangilik-ku!

sentences.text: There's a new Uzbek restaurant near the station. — **Is there?** Let's try it.
sentences.translation: Vokzal yaqinida yangi o'zbek restorani ochilibdi. — **Shunaqami?** Keling, borib ko'raylik.

sentences.text: The children weren't at school yesterday. — **Weren't they?** Were they ill?
sentences.translation: Bolalar kecha maktabda bo'lishmadi. — **Bo'lishmadimi?** Kasal bo'lib qolishganmi?

examples.title: Echo questions: **Do you?** **Does she?** **Did they?**
examples.description: Present Simple va Past Simple gaplariga qayta so'roq **do / does / did** bilan: I work in a bank. — **Do you?** Inkor gapga — inkor: I don't drink coffee. — **Don't you?**

sentences.text: I work in a bank. — **Do you?** Which one?
sentences.translation: Men bankda ishlayman. — **Shunaqami?** Qaysi bankda?

sentences.text: Madina speaks four languages. — **Does she?** That's amazing.
sentences.translation: Madina to'rtta tilda gapiradi. — **Rostdanmi?** Ajoyib-ku.

sentences.text: I don't drink coffee at all. — **Don't you?** Not even in the morning?
sentences.translation: Men umuman qahva ichmayman. — **Ichmaysizmi?** Hatto ertalab ham-a?

sentences.text: We went to Samarkand at the weekend. — **Did you?** How was it?
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari Samarqandga bordik. — **Bordingizmi?** Qalay bo'ldi?

sentences.text: Tom doesn't eat bread. — **Doesn't he?** Why not?
sentences.translation: Tom non yemaydi. — **Yemaydimi?** Nega endi?

sentences.text: My phone broke this morning. — **Did it?** Can you fix it?
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab telefonim buzilib qoldi. — **Shunaqami?** Tuzata olasizmi?

sentences.text: Sarah didn't like the hotel. — **Didn't she?** I thought it was lovely.
sentences.translation: Saraga mehmonxona yoqmadi. — **Yoqmadimi?** Men uni juda yaxshi deb o'ylagandim.

sentences.text: Aziz and his wife live in Manchester now. — **Do they?** Since when?
sentences.translation: Aziz xotini bilan endi Manchesterda yashaydi. — **Shunaqami?** Qachondan beri?

sentences.text: Our cat sleeps about sixteen hours a day. — **Does it?** Lucky cat!
sentences.translation: Mushugimiz kuniga o'n olti soatcha uxlaydi. — **Rostdanmi?** Baxtli mushuk ekan!

sentences.text: I didn't sleep at all last night. — **Didn't you?** You should go to bed early tonight.
sentences.translation: Kecha tunda umuman uxlamadim. — **Uxlamadingizmi?** Bugun erta yotishingiz kerak.

examples.title: Echo questions: **Have you?** **Can't he?** **Will it?**
examples.description: have / has, can, could, will bilan qayta so'roq: gapdagi yordamchi fe'l qaytariladi. **never** inkor so'z, shuning uchun has never been → **Hasn't he?**

sentences.text: I've lost my keys again. — **Have you?** Where did you last see them?
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni yana yo'qotib qo'ydim. — **Yo'qotdingizmi?** Oxirgi marta qayerda ko'rgandingiz?

sentences.text: Dilnoza can play the piano. — **Can she?** I'd love to hear her.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza pianino chala oladi. — **Shunaqami?** Uning chalishini eshitgim keladi.

sentences.text: James can't come to the party. — **Can't he?** That's a shame.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ziyofatga kela olmaydi. — **Kela olmaydimi?** Attang.

sentences.text: We haven't got any milk. — **Haven't we?** I'll buy some.
sentences.translation: Sutimiz qolmabdi. — **Qolmadimi?** Men olib kelaman.

sentences.text: The new bridge will open next month. — **Will it?** That's good news for drivers.
sentences.translation: Yangi ko'prik kelasi oy ochiladi. — **Shunaqami?** Haydovchilar uchun yaxshi xabar.

sentences.text: My brother has never been on a plane. — **Hasn't he?** Not even once?
sentences.translation: Akam hech qachon samolyotda uchmagan. — **Uchmaganmi?** Bir marta ham-a?

sentences.text: I won't be at work tomorrow. — **Won't you?** Are you ill?
sentences.translation: Ertaga ishda bo'lmayman. — **Bo'lmaysizmi?** Kasalmisiz?

sentences.text: Emma has passed her driving test. — **Has she?** Good for her!
sentences.translation: Emma haydovchilik imtihonidan o'tdi. — **O'tdimi?** Barakalla!

sentences.text: I couldn't find a parking space. — **Couldn't you?** Where did you leave the car?
sentences.translation: Mashina qo'yishga joy topa olmadim. — **Topa olmadingizmi?** Mashinani qayerda qoldirdingiz?

sentences.text: They've already sold their house in Bukhara. — **Have they?** Where are they going to live?
sentences.translation: Ular Buxorodagi uyini allaqachon sotib yuborishibdi. — **Shunaqami?** Endi qayerda yashashmoqchi?

examples.title: Question tags: ..., **isn't it?** / ..., **aren't you?**
examples.description: **be** bilan darak gap + inkor dumcha: ..., **isn't it**? / ..., **weren't we**? Dumcha suhbatdoshdan rozilik so'raydi — o'zbekcha «-a?», «shundaymi?», «to'g'rimi?». **I'm** ning dumchasi — **aren't I**?

sentences.text: It's a beautiful day, **isn't it**?
sentences.translation: Bugun havo ajoyib, **a**?

sentences.text: You're Madina's brother, **aren't you**?
sentences.translation: Siz Madinaning akasisiz, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: The film was great, **wasn't it**?
sentences.translation: Film zo'r edi, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: Tom and Sarah are married, **aren't they**?
sentences.translation: Tom bilan Sara turmush qurgan, **shunday emasmi**?

sentences.text: This seat is free, **isn't it**? — Yes, please sit down.
sentences.translation: Bu joy bo'sh, **shundaymi**? — Ha, marhamat, o'tiring.

sentences.text: We were in the same class at school, **weren't we**?
sentences.translation: Biz maktabda bir sinfda o'qiganmiz, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: Your sister is studying in Oxford, **isn't she**?
sentences.translation: Opangiz Oksfordda o'qiyapti, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: I'm in the right room for the English exam, **aren't I**?
sentences.translation: Ingliz tili imtihoni uchun to'g'ri xonaga keldim, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: Breakfast is included in the price, **isn't it**? — Yes, it is.
sentences.translation: Nonushta narxga kiritilgan, **shundaymi**? — Ha, kiritilgan.

sentences.text: The weather was terrible in Manchester last week, **wasn't it**?
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta Manchesterda havo dahshatli edi, **a**?

examples.title: Question tags: ..., **don't you?** / ..., **didn't she?**
examples.description: Present Simple va Past Simple darak gapida yordamchi fe'l ko'rinmaydi, shuning uchun dumchada **don't / doesn't / didn't** keladi: You like tea, **don't you**? («isn't it» emas!).

sentences.text: You like green tea, **don't you**?
sentences.translation: Siz ko'k choyni yaxshi ko'rasiz, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: Aziz works at the airport, **doesn't he**?
sentences.translation: Aziz aeroportda ishlaydi, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: The train leaves at six, **doesn't it**?
sentences.translation: Poyezd soat oltida jo'naydi, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: You saw Emma yesterday, **didn't you**? How is she?
sentences.translation: Kecha Emmani ko'rdingiz, **shundaymi**? U qalay?

sentences.text: Your parents live near the market, **don't they**?
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz bozor yaqinida yashaydi, **a**?

sentences.text: James forgot his umbrella again, **didn't he**? Look, it's still here.
sentences.translation: Jeyms yana soyabonini unutib ketdi, **a**? Qarang, hali ham shu yerda.

sentences.text: Dilnoza teaches maths at a school in Samarkand, **doesn't she**?
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Samarqanddagi maktabda matematikadan dars beradi, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: We met at Bekzod's wedding, **didn't we**? — Yes, that's right!
sentences.translation: Biz Bekzodning to'yida tanishganmiz, **shundaymi**? — Ha, to'g'ri!

sentences.text: This shop opens at eight, **doesn't it**?
sentences.translation: Bu do'kon soat sakkizda ochiladi, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: You enjoyed the trip to Bukhara, **didn't you**? — I loved it!
sentences.translation: Buxoroga sayohat sizga yoqdi, **a**? — Juda yoqdi!

examples.title: Negative sentence, positive tag: ..., **is it?**
examples.description: Inkor gapdan keyin dumcha darak bo'ladi: It isn't far, **is it**? You don't smoke, **do you**? Javob faktga qarab: «Siz ... emassiz, shundaymi?» — **No, I'm not** (= Ha, emasman).

sentences.text: It isn't very far, **is it**?
sentences.translation: Bu unchalik uzoq emas, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: You don't eat meat, **do you**?
sentences.translation: Siz go'sht yemaysiz, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: Madina wasn't at the meeting, **was she**?
sentences.translation: Madina yig'ilishda yo'q edi, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: You haven't seen my glasses, **have you**? — No, sorry, I haven't.
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagimni ko'rmadingiz, **a**? — Yo'q, kechirasiz, ko'rmadim.

sentences.text: Tom can't speak Russian, **can he**?
sentences.translation: Tom ruscha gapira olmaydi, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: The children didn't break the window, **did they**?
sentences.translation: Derazani bolalar sindirmagan, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: We don't need tickets for the museum, **do we**?
sentences.translation: Muzeyga kirish uchun chipta kerak emas, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: You aren't from Uzbekistan, **are you**? — **No, I'm not**. I'm from Kazakhstan.
sentences.translation: Siz O'zbekistondan emassiz, **shundaymi**? — **Ha, emasman**. Qozog'istondanman.

sentences.text: Bekzod won't forget the cake, **will he**? — Don't worry, he won't.
sentences.translation: Bekzod tortni unutib qo'ymaydi, **a**? — Xavotir olmang, unutmaydi.

sentences.text: Sarah hasn't finished her report yet, **has she**? — **Yes, she has**. She sent it this morning.
sentences.translation: Sara hali hisobotini tugatmagan, **shundaymi**? — **Yo'q, tugatgan**. Bugun ertalab yubordi.

examples.title: Tags with **have**, **can**, **will**, **should**
examples.description: Dumchada gapning o'z yordamchi fe'li: You've been ..., **haven't you**? Aziz can ..., **can't he**? Let's ... dan keyin — **shall we**?

sentences.text: You've been to London before, **haven't you**?
sentences.translation: Siz oldin Londonda bo'lgansiz, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: Aziz can drive, **can't he**? He could take us to the airport.
sentences.translation: Aziz mashina hayday oladi, **to'g'rimi**? U bizni aeroportga olib borishi mumkin.

sentences.text: It'll be cold in the mountains, **won't it**?
sentences.translation: Tog'da sovuq bo'ladi, **a**?

sentences.text: We should leave now, **shouldn't we**? It's getting dark.
sentences.translation: Hozir yo'lga chiqishimiz kerak, **shundaymi**? Qorong'i tushyapti.

sentences.text: Emma can't come on Friday, **can she**? — No, she's busy.
sentences.translation: Emma juma kuni kela olmaydi, **shundaymi**? — Ha, u band.

sentences.text: Your father has retired now, **hasn't he**?
sentences.translation: Otangiz endi nafaqaga chiqqan, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: Let's take a taxi, **shall we**? The bags are really heavy.
sentences.translation: Taksiga o'tiraylik, **xo'pmi**? Sumkalar juda og'ir.

sentences.text: The guests have already arrived, **haven't they**?
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar allaqachon kelishdi, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza could help us with the translation, **couldn't she**?
sentences.translation: Dilnoza tarjimada bizga yordam bera olardi, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: You'll call me when you get to Samarkand, **won't you**? — Of course I will.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga yetib borganingizda qo'ng'iroq qilasiz, **a**? — Albatta qilaman.

examples.title: Dialogue: meeting an old friend
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: eski do'stlar uchrashuvi. Qayta so'roqlar (**Did you? Are you? Have you?**) va dumchalar (**isn't it? don't you? shall we?**) suhbatda qanday ishlashini kuzating.

sentences.text: — Bekzod? It's you, **isn't it**? I haven't seen you for years!
sentences.translation: — Bekzod? Bu sensan, **shundaymi**? Seni ko'rmaganimga ancha yillar bo'ldi!

sentences.text: — Madina! You look great. You live in London now, **don't you**?
sentences.translation: — Madina! Juda yaxshi ko'rinyapsan. Hozir Londonda yashaysan, **a**?

sentences.text: — **I don't**, actually. I moved to Manchester last spring.
sentences.translation: — Aslida **yashamayman**. O'tgan bahor Manchesterga ko'chib o'tdim.

sentences.text: — **Did you**? And are you still working for that bank?
sentences.translation: — **Shunaqami**? Hali ham o'sha bankda ishlayapsanmi?

sentences.text: — No, **I'm not**. I teach English at a college now.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **ishlamayman**. Endi kollejda ingliz tilidan dars beraman.

sentences.text: — **Are you**? You always loved English, **didn't you**?
sentences.translation: — **Rostdanmi**? Ingliz tilini doim yaxshi ko'rarding, **a**?

sentences.text: — Yes, **I did**. And what about you? You're married now, **aren't you**?
sentences.translation: — Ha, **yaxshi ko'rardim**. O'zing-chi? Uylangansan, **shundaymi**?

sentences.text: — **I am**. And we've got a little daughter. She's two.
sentences.translation: — **Ha**. Kichkina qizimiz ham bor, ikki yoshda.

sentences.text: — **Have you**? How lovely! What's her name?
sentences.translation: — **Shunaqami**? Qanday yoqimli! Ismi nima?

sentences.text: — Laylo. Let's have a coffee and talk, **shall we**?
sentences.translation: — Laylo. Keling, qahva ichib gaplashaylik, **xo'pmi**?
